clips.title: The story
paras: At the Shrine of Aessina, night elves honor an ancient spirit of nature and wild creatures. The sacred place lies in southwestern Ashenvale, between Maestra's Post and Astranaar, amid growing border friction.

West of Astranaar, the Shrine of Aessina honors a Wild God who embodies the heart and spirit of the deep forests. For generations, night elves and their woodland kin have revered this quiet place and communed with nature away from the main roads. The Horde is pushing into Ashenvale to gather timber and establish footholds, and sacred grounds across the territory face an uncertain peace.
